text: Taala was a monstrous Sporemound created by Gnarlgar and the primals to destroy the Apexis arakkoa roughly 2,000 years before the opening of the Dark Portal. The Sporemound was killed by the Apexis superweapon, the Breath of Rukhmar, forever destroying the Evergrowth.

Tacha is a vulpera quest giver located on the western outskirts of the Court of Zak'rajan in Vol'dun alongside Kenzou and Omi. She claims to have sacked countless ruins across Vol'dun, from saurolisk dens to the Port of Zem'lan, and has survived because she takes her time, avoids risks, and only takes what she needs. According to Omi, Tacha loves cursed idols and can turn soul-filled golem eyes into "hilarious little bombs". When an adventurer arrives at the Court of Zak'rajan, Tacha asks them to investigate the Malfunctioning Golem and discover the power source of the golems that roam the ruins. After the adventurer discovers that the golems are powered by Zandalari souls, Tacha is unfazed

The Tainted Forest is an expanse of the revitalized area in the Tainted Scar, created thanks to the efforts of a worgen druid named Marl Wormthorn. At the time of the Cataclysm, Wormthorn created the great tree Maldraz with his immense power and managed to reclaim and bring back the Tainted Scar to its former, greener self. At first, it was a success and the forest was restored, allowing the refugees to build Surwich where the Tainted Scar was once present. However, the residual demonic powers left on the land began to take their toll, and while Wormthorn's attention was drawn to fighting back the demonic taint, the nathrezim who had formerly resided there took the opportunity to infiltrate

Taking this Show on the Road is an achievement earned from having all 4 of the band's roles assigned to you at the Blight Boar concert on Darkmoon Island.
Tame Beast is a level 5 hunter ability that allows the hunter to train beasts and make them their life-long companions. Hunters starting in Exile's Reach unlock this ability during Taming the Wilds.

Talonbranch Glade is an Alliance outpost in the northern parts of Felwood. Gilnean worgen were sent to Talonbranch in order to help the night elves with defending it from the attacking goblins from the Bilgewater Cartel; the Glade then turning into a prominent Gilnean outpost. Talonbranch Glade is located south of Timbermaw Hold, which leads to Moonglade and Winterspring. Prior to the Cataclysm, Talonbranch Glade was a small night elven post, comprised of a house moonwell and various other night elven scenery. As of the Cataclysm, The Glade stretches down into the ramp entrances, boasting Gilnean structures, Gilnean flags, and a large tree similar to Tal'doren in the Blackwald. According to

The Talondeep Path was a winding tunnel that connected Ashenvale with the Stonetalon Mountains. Although it was riddled with small dead ends and interesting holes in the walls, there were no friendly NPCs nor hostile mobs inside. The entrance on the Ashenvale side was found just west of Mystral Lake, while the entrance on the Stonetalon side was found in the northwestern part of Windshear Crag. In the wake of the Cataclysm, goblins blasted this cavern open, making a larger (and mountable) pass through the mountain called the Talondeep Pass.
__NOTOC__ Talionia is a blood elf warlock trainer located in The Sanctum in Murder Row in Silvermoon City. She was present in the Court of the Sun during the closing of the remembrance ceremony.

Talramas is a Scourge necropolis which crashed due to a malfunction near the Festering Pools in the Borean Tundra. Lich-Lord Chillwinter was in command of the necropolis. Chillwinter urged them to work faster, in order to make the necropolis airborne again by the end of the day, or else the Lich King would destroy all of them. At some point during the war against the Lich King, the gnome engineers led by Fizzcrank Fullthrottle founded Fizzcrank Airstrip in the region above the Geyser Fields, as they thought it was an ideal location to launch recon flights, and because it was also near the crashed necropolis Talramas, so they could scrounge interesting mechanical parts from it.

]] Talondeep Vale is a forested location between Silverwind Refuge, Talondeep Pass, and the Ruins of Stardust. Stardust Spire is located in or near here. The Ashenvale side of the Talondeep Path used to start here before the Shattering destroyed it. pl:Talondeep Vale
Tamara Sigmund is a human flight master found in Nesingwary's Retreat in Highmountain.
Tallian is a nightborne leatherworker located in Suramar City. He was responsible for exiling Stalriss Dawnrunner from the city.

The Tamed Hippogryph was used as Tyrande Whisperwind's mount during the War of the Thorns. Flying from Darnassus, Tyrande briefly observed Teldrassil's other parts and reached Darkshore, seeking Malfurion Stormrage. After securing Malfurion, Tyrande tasked the Alliance adventurer to use the hippogryph to reach Darnassus to aid in the evacuation of citizens.

__NOTOC__ Tannysa is a night elf artisan herbalism trainer located in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City. She offers training to those wishing to learn the art of herbalism and is one of the foremost herbalism trainers in the city. She can be found standing outside the alchemy shop Alchemy Needs in the far eastern section of the Mage Quarter.
__NOTOC__ Tana is a blood elf hunter trainer located at Rangers' Lodge in Silvermoon City. She was present in the Court of the Sun during the closing of the remembrance ceremony.

During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, the Deathlord sought knowledge of the fallen red dragon Kyranastrasz. Tania Summerbreeze is a pandaren flight master located on The Golden Terrace of the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Tamper-Proof Teleportation Mines are land mines located in a house in the Dwarven District of the Vision of Stormwind. Stepping on one will teleport the adventurer to the start of the house. Make it past them all to find the Experimental Buff Mine and explanation in the Engineer's Note found upstairs.

A taunt is an effect or ability that forces mobs to focus on the caster for a short time, regardless of threat levels. Most taunt abilities also increase threat generation while they're active. All classes with a tank specialization have a taunt.

Tarren Mill is a Forsaken town located in northern Hillsbrad Foothills, near the Alterac Mountains. Prior to the Third War, Tarren Mill was a simple Lordaeronian town. At some point after the Third War, Forsaken afterward, where it served as the staging point against the Alliance forces of Southshore and Dun Garok. After the Cataclysm, the town was improved and reinforced. Tarren Mill now stands as a bastion of the Forsaken power, while its former rival Southshore lies in ruins.

Tarvim Daywalker is a Highmountain tauren tending to two wounded braves in a hut in Snowmane Village in Highmountain. He needs to be evacuated during Evacuate Snowmane, but since he refuses to leave the braves behind to die, he simply picks them both up and carries them to safety.

Taurson, the Beastly Boxer, is a Highmountain tauren vignette found in a boxing cave south of Skyhorn in Highmountain. Players who approach him can challenge him to a fight. After sufficiently damaging Taurson, he admits defeat and runs out of the cave, allowing the player to loot Taurson's Champion Belt from Taurson's Prize.

Tarthen was a promising but arrogant young spellcaster and a member of the Tirisgarde, the order of magi created by the Council of Tirisfal to hunt down and subdue the wayward Guardian Aegwynn. Tarthen's elderly master had long ago inherited the powerful greatstaff Ebonchill, and was in the process of choosing which apprentice would take it up next. Tarthen fully expected to receive the staff, as he eclipsed his fellow apprentices in raw power and potential. However, his master put little weight in such things, and on the day of the ceremony he instead gave Ebonchill to another apprentice, who embodied the qualities of compassion, wisdom and comradery. Tarthen wallowed in anger and bitternes
Taurnash the Heretic is a Highmountain tauren located in Feltotem in Highmountain.
Tau Li is a pandaren monk located at Thunder Totem in Highmountain, training some Highmountain Trainees.

__NOTOC__ Tavar was a young night elf rogue who participated in the War of the Thorns. He could take lives, and had, and was highly skilled at disguising himself as other races and working with the shadows. Delaryn Summermoon thought that Elune had blessed him with a gift, albeit a dark one. Shortly after Horde forces froze the Falfarren River in Ashenvale to allow them to cross, Tavar arrived and informed Commander Summermoon that Malfurion Stormrage was on his way. Delaryn asked what Tavar's skills were, and he demonstrated by stepping into some nearby shadows and disappearing. Delaryn was impressed and told Tavar to gather a team of the druids who had informed him of Malfurion's arrival,
Taz'anga Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.

Tehd Shoemaker is a Forsaken warlock who appears in various locations around the Broken Isles including Azsuna, Highmountain, Stormheim and Val'sharah, fighting various powerful demons alongside his partner, Marius Felbane. The two have a professional relationship, not liking each other but acknowledging that they need each other's help. Helping Tehd and his partner is the subject of the achievement Tehd & Marius' Excellent Adventure. Tehd later appears at the Hijacked Portal on the Broken Shore. Despite being a warlock, Tehd does not summon demons to fight for him, though he has been shown to be very knowledgeable about tracking and restraining demons, shown when he was able to capture Doom
Team Deathmatch is a Island Expeditions achievement earned for killing all of the opposite factions champions during the Island Expeditions.
Technique: Songs of the Legion was never made available. The recipe is instead taught by Thoth in the Exodar and Zantasia in Silvermoon City.

Teldrassil (meaning "Crown of the Earth" in Darnassian, and pronounced TELL-druh-sill) was a World Tree situated on the eponymous island off Kalimdor's northwestern coast. Created shortly after the Third War by the night elves, Teldrassil served as their home and primary base of operations, its thick crown housing the capital city of Darnassus. Other major settlements on the tree included Rut'theran Village, Dolanaar and Shadowglen. Owing to its size, Teldrassil possessed its own unique ecosystem with a various flora, fauna, and vast twilit forests. Teleport is a useful line of utility spells that allows the caster to quickly transport themselves to another friendly location (with most spells transporting to a capital city).

The Temple of Arkkoran was a former temple of Elune located on the northeastern shores of Azshara and it was where the sea giant Arkkoroc lived. He could be found at the top level of the temple and was guarded by murlocs and makrura who attacked on sight. The Shattered Strand, which the temple was located on, is also under watch by hydras and aggressive sea giants. The temple is a popular farming spot because of the Stormshroud Armor patterns ( and ) and that drop there. The temple was destroyed in the Cataclysm, leaving only few ruins behind.

Telaar is the Kurenai-factioned Alliance town in southern Nagrand. The flight point is at 54,75, on top of the inn. It is accessed via exterior ramps on either side of the building. Telaar is full of draenei, both of normal and Broken. There are plenty of quests to be had, goods to be bought, and things to see. Telaar is also one of the only intact examples of undamaged Draenei architecture in all of what is left of Draenor. The Kurenai quartermaster is here, as is a stable master and a mailbox, in addition to the flight master and inn mentioned above.
__NOTOC__ Teloren is a hippogryph flight master located at Thal'darah Overlook in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Teleport from Azshara Tower is a utility debuff used by the quest Return Trip. It roots players in place and teleports them back to Sanath's camp in Azshara.
The Teleporter is a level 70 ethereal offering to teleport players directly to other friendly races' starting areas. He exists in all starting areas.

Teldrassil is a level 1-10 Alliance zone, the starting zone for night elves. It begins with the night elf starting experience in Shadowglen, then proceeds to Dolanaar. The main plot involves investigating the corruption affecting the creatures of Teldrassil — a remnant of the curse that fell upon the colossal tree after when the Aspects refused to bless it — and traveling between the different moonwells to gather samples of water needed to reveal and destroy the corruption's source. Throughout the plot, the hero sees multiple visions explaining the major developments in night elf society since the Battle of Mount Hyjal.

Teleport to the Seabolt is an object located at on the southern beach of Za'Tual on the Isle of Thunder in line of sight of the three Alliance ships anchored offshore. The central ship is The Seabolt, where the teleporter will send players who interact with it.

Teleport: Hall of the Guardian is a spell used by the mage to teleport to their Class Hall, the Hall of the Guardian. It places them just inside the entrance on the Hall's first floor. It is rewarded from the quest The Dreadlord's Prize.

Teleporter Repair Kit is purchased from Archivist Roh-Suir at Tier 3 for 50 Cataloged Research at the Reliquary of Remembrance at Keeper's Respite in Korthia. Use the repair kits to open Ancient Teleporters to gain access to the Chamber of Wisdom and Chamber of Knowledge.
Teleport Scroll: Undercity Zeppelin Tower is a quest reward from Talented.
Teleport Scroll: Shattrath City is a quest reward from Talented.
Teleportation Crystal is given by Virtos and Knight-Lord Dranarus for quick teleportation to the Vindicaar during Prophecy Stirs.

__NOTOC__ Tenaron Stormgrip is a night elf located in Aldrassil in Teldrassil. Tenaron briefly appears in Molten Front at its moonwell. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Its columns and the circlet of its open roof rimmed with snow. The sound of lightning cracking fills the air even when the sky is clear and the lights of the north dance across the stars. It was built by the titans long ago and now serves as the sanctum of the titan keeper Thorim, the Stormlord. The Temple of the Moon (or the Temple of Elune) in Darnassus was a major temple dedicated to the goddess Elune, the dwelling and moonlit sanctum of the Sisters of Elune, and the center of all night elven spiritual life. The temple also served as the seat of government in Darnassus and Teldrassil, with the night elven leaders High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind and Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage residing here. Incidentally, it was one of the largest artificial structures in the region. The building itself was built in Darnassus following the Battle of Mount Hyjal that ended the Third War. Terokk's Rest is an island in Blackwind Lake located in Skettis in southeastern Terokkar Forest. It is only available to those who have flight. As of patch 2.1, there exists a questline to summon and slay Terokk, the god of the arakkoa, at this location.

The Terrace of the Makers is located in the northcentral area of the Storm Peaks, across the chasm from Ulduar. It is a complex of temples and other buildings where the keepers made their homes and worked. This is the place where the artifacts expected in Ulduar are stored. The terrace shows a great deal of damage, while the broken Path of the Titans, walkways shattered, columns cracked and missing. The Plain of Echoes is to the east, while the Valley of Ancient Winters is to the south. The Hall of the Shaper is situated on the eastern side of the mountain on the terrace and is guarded by Iron Sentinels. The Temple of Earth is a temple in the center and lower shelf of Deepholm. It was here, in the Stonecore, that the Twilight's Hammer brought Deathwing back to full health and forged him new armor. A titan-made stone called the World Pillar was kept inside. This item bore the weight of all the elemental and magnetic forces in Deepholm. When Deathwing became fully healed, it was he who destroyed the pillar, causing the Shattering. Now, the Earthen Ring work in desperation to recover the fragments of the pillar and restore the temple. All of Deepholm would collapse into Azeroth if the World Pillar is not put back together. The Temple of Uldum is a temple found on top of the northwestern most mountain in Uldum. It's the Coffer of Promise is protected in an invisible magic force field. Brann Bronzebeard appears from the coffer, after he causes it to kill Commander Schnottz and his two black dragon guards. The coffer is later moved to the Cradle of the Ancients by Harrison Jones. After N'Zoth was released, the temple became a breeding ground for aqir.
Temple of Kotmogu All-Star is a player vs. player achievement earned for holding four Orbs of Power and killing four Orb-carrying enemies in a single Temple of Kotmogu match.
Terrace of the Stars is a highest point in Anguish Fortress. Here, shows the power of the . He summons Arkeddon with the sacrifice of Samaara.
Tenpak Flametotem is a Highmountain tauren vignette found at the western edge of the Haglands in Highmountain. He is standing amidst several charred animal corpses next to a burning building.

__NOTOC__ Tercin Shivenllher is an apparent blood elf aristocrat wandering Silvermoon City with his Arcane Demolisher. In truth, he is a homunculus created by the Burning Legion to infiltrate their enemies.

The Terrace of the Moon is a large section of the Tomb of Sargeras, being the halls of the Sisterhood of Elune. The Sisters of the Moon are fought here on a platform called the Font of Elune. Illidan comments that he has been to this location. He warns the adventurers that the spirits won't be friendly or forgiving to them.
The Temple of Light is an important religious building located within the city of Stratholme. It belonged to the Church of the Holy Light until it fell with the rest of the city to the Scourge.

Terror Wing Path is the valley located in the eastern region of the Burning Steppes. Terror Wing is home to many whelps and dragonkin of the black dragonflight. In the southeastern section of Terror Wing Path the goblin-built Redridge Pass runs high into the hills, leading all the way through Redridge Mountains and into the Swamp of Sorrows. Sharon Boomgetter provides travelers with a one-way trip on the highway, going to the resort town of Bogpaddle.

Testing the Tonic is a Horde quest in Thousand Needles that requires players to take the Crate of Reagents from Wizlo Bearingshiner in Whitereach Post to Magistrix Elosai in Freewind Post so she can finish her experiments in finding a cure for the Blood Elves' magical addiction. You must have completed A Dip in the Moonwell in order to get this quest.

Test of Strength is a Horde quest in Thousand Needles in which player characters test their strength against the rock elemental Rok'Alim the Pounder. It is the third quest in the Test of Faith quest chain, which is a chain of quest involving "testing" some part of the player character's being. The first quest is Test of Faith (quest), which begins in The Weathered Nook in Thousand Needles, from Dorn Plainstalker.

Terror of the Tides is the Sentinels campaign in Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne. Sometime after the defeat of the Burning Legion, Maiev Shadowsong, leader of the Watchers, began her quest to capture Illidan following his release from the prisons of the barrows. Maiev discovered that Illidan had become a demon and now commanded the Naga, ancient night elves who transformed into serpent-like sea creatures and with their help gained the power of the Eye of Sargeras. Without the power to confront Illidan, she managed to send a messenger to receive aid from Malfurion and after withstanding the naga's attack, Maiev eventually received reinforcements from Malfurion, but was displeased that Tyrande

Thal'darah Grove was a druid training ground located at the heart of Battlescar Valley in the Stonetalon Mountains. This ancient tree had been a place of peace and learning for generations and had been used by both the night elves and tauren. Overlord Krom'gar believed this to be the location of a weapon of mass destruction that would be used against the Horde when they got the chance. It played a key role in a quest chain involving a bomb. The quest ended when the bomb was dropped on Thal'darah Grove ultimately destroying it. Before the destruction, some druids were rescued by the Alliance.

Thala Steeltotem is a Highmountain tauren blacksmithing vendor found at the Ironhorn Enclave in Highmountain. She is overseeing the blacksmithing training of Kiyale Shalehoof, Sturm Oakenhorn and Apashuala Ironhide. Her father, who wielded a hammer known as Grayheft, fell to the drogbar several years ago.

Terror by Torchlight is a short story by Christie Golden released on the official site on November 2, 2020. It features Mathias Shaw and Flynn Fairwind working together to obtain a powerful artifact and stop an undead army from overwhelming Duskwood, and serves as a prequel to the book Exploring Azeroth: The Eastern Kingdoms.
Tharm is a tauren flight master located at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Thaon Moonclaw is a night elf quest giver located at Moonclaw Vale in Val'sharah. He is one of three ancient Archdruids of Val'sharah.
Thandiel Whitemoon is a night elf that would appear in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City prior to the discovery of Pandaria.

"Thaurissan" may refer to: *Thaurissan family, a family of Dark Iron dwarves. *Ruins of Thaurissan, a ruined Dark Iron city in what is now the Burning Steppes, named after the Sorcerer-Thane. *Kingdom of Thaurissan *Server: Thaurissan US, a US Oceania realm.

Thaumaturges are practitioners of magic found mostly in the ranks of ethereals. They know how to charge magical items, and their technomancy allows them to modify an item's arcane essence in ways previously unimaginable or house items in a pocket dimension. Other representants include night elves and blood elves.

The Anvil is an Iron golem which is the bodyguard of Iron Thane Furyhammer. The Anvil will shield Furyhammer from all damage until the player's golem uses its EMP ability. This will stun it, and allow damage to be done to Furyhammer for a short period of time. The Anvil has one ability, Molten Blast: Unleashes a wave of flame, inflicting Fire damage to nearby enemies and reducing their movement speed for 6 sec.

The Art of Dragonflight is a book containing 207 pages of art including never-before-seen images from the archives of the Blizzard Film Department and the World of Warcraft development team. It was included in the Dragonflight Collector's Edition.

The Celestial Planetarium and its Heroic mode equivalent Heroic: The Celestial Planetarium is the second step in the Algalon the Observer attunement quest chain. Simply waltz across the antechamber to the east end of the wing and kill the guardian in front of the door.

The Earthen Ring has sent representatives to the horde and alliance, seeking help communing with the spirits of Shadowmoon Valley, and healing the damage done to the valley. In the process, you discover how the land was shattered, and defeat an elemental lord. This quest has several dialogs and a couple of cut scenes that explain details not found otherwise.
The Condensation of Electra-Atrocity is a book found on the Lightning Ledge of Mount Hyjal. Presumably written by , it covers the discovery of the new (to him) properties of "Electra-atrocity".

He is wearing the stolen skull of a long-dead Highmountain tauren named Oenia Skyhorn, whose ghost asks adventurers to kill the Candleking and take back her skull so that she can go back to rest. Before adventurers are allowed entry into the Candleking's inner chamber by the Bluewax Gatekeeper, however, they need to perform several minor tasks for the kobolds in the cavern.

The Darkmoon Faire is an introductory quest given out by Darkmoon Faire Mystic Mage (originally Kruban Darkblade in Orgrimmar) to attract players to the faire.

The Curator is an Arcane Guardian boss in the Menagerie in Karazhan. It is not optional, raids wanting to kill the bosses behind it must first defeat The Curator. The encounter is not difficult to learn, but is (for new raids) a rather hard gear check. A raid able to defeat this boss is in principle equipped well enough to clear the whole instance, save perhaps Nightbane and Prince Malchezaar. Massive, powerful, fast and and above all surprisingly fast, Mathias Shaw's reports mentions the Curator as a formidable opponent. The Dangers of Magic Abuse is a book in Dalaran which can spawn in place of The Schools of Arcane Magic.

The Flight from Lordaeron is chapter 2 of the Legacy of the Damned campaign. It is the first battle of the Civil War in the Plaguelands which is a series of battles between the various undead factions in control of the forces of the Scourge: the forces controlled by Arthas and Kel'thuzad (serving the will of the Lich King), the forces under the control of the Dreadlords (thus loyal to the Burning Legion) and, finally, a third faction of Undead free of the Lich King's will gathered by Sylvanas Windrunner, later known as the Forsaken, and strengthened by the minions of the traitor Dreadlord Varimathras.

"the Explorer" is a title awarded for completing Universal Explorer, for which you must completely explore all of the world maps for all continents in the game (Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor, Outland, Northrend, the areas revealed by the Cataclysm, Pandaria, , and the Broken Isles). The title comes after the player's name, in the following format: : the Explorer In addition to the title, players will receive the Tabard of the Explorer in the mail, upon completion of the exploration of Northrend. Due to the terrain of Northrend, the achievement is not possible without Cold Weather Flying, or some corpse running to get on to ledges that cannot be accessed by walking.

Torghast, Tower of the Damned is an infinite dungeon in World of Warcraft: Shadowlands that can be played by 1 to up to 5 players. It sits at the center of the Maw. Torghast is an endlessly replayable, ever-changing dungeon that can be challenged alone or in a group. Each run will differ, and adventurers will need to explore cautiously, as death comes at a terrible cost. Advance through Torghast's unpredictable challenges to unlock anima powers to enhance damage output or survivability. The goal is Soul Ash, used to craft the legendary weapons and armor that will help restore balance to the Shadowlands.

The Tradesmen's Terrace is a large district in the southern portion of Darnassus, the night elf capital. The terrace is the center of commerce in the city, hosting most vendors and shopkeepers, as well as Darnassus's auction house. The Toxic Airfield is a zone of Dun Morogh filled with Toxic Sludges and Living Contaminations. After Operation: Gnomeregan and the Irradiator 3000, that which remained after the explosion turned into Toxic Airfield we know it today. Towers of Power is a player vs. player achievement earned for destroying 3 siege engines in a single battle for Tol Barad.

The Trade Wars (or cartel wars) were conflicts that happened on the island of Kezan, fought between various goblin cartels. The exact time period they occurred is unknown, though Druz fought in them, and Ziya was a child during them. There were at least four Trade Wars and were followed by the Peace War, which was supposedly even worse. The Trade Wars didn't have very defined front lines, with combat occurring in tunnels and storerooms throughout the Undermine. "Ambushes" consisted of enemy goblins kicking down walls. Jastor Gallywix's favorite bakery was destroyed and rebuilt over the course of the multiple wars, and finally melted during the Peace War.

Tranquillien is a town located in the Ghostlands, on the western slope of Sungraze Peak overlooking the Dead Scar. It is surrounded by hostile forces, most notably the Scourge of Deatholme. Resources are therefore in perennial short supply, and communications from Silvermoon City are at best infrequent. Tranquillien is populated by both blood elves and the Forsaken. The two races have formed a faction that is overseen by Dame Auriferous and High Executor Mavren, along with their lieutenants, Advisor Valwyn and Deathstalker Maltendis.

Transcendence is a monk ability available to all specializations. It leaves the monk's spirit behind in a certain location, allowing the later use of Transcendence: Transfer to swap locations, essentially being a limited teleport.

Transcendence: Transfer is a monk ability granted by the Transcendence talent. It allows the monk to instantly travel to the place they last used Transcendence, essentially being a limited Teleport function. Its cooldown is reduced by the PvP talent Eminence.

Trainer Kod is a Highmountain tauren overseeing a boxing cave south of Skyhorn in Highmountain, where Skyhorn and Rivermane Boxers are training and competing to become as skilled as "The Beastly Boxer", Taurson.

Travel Form is a druid shapeshifting spell available at level 10, or learned from A Druid's Form. It allows the druid to move faster depending on the environment. At level 17, Aquatic Form is learned, allowing Travel Form to be used underwater with the benefits of increased swim speed and underwater breathing. Rank 2 is learned at level 20, causing Travel Form to gain an additional 60% movement speed while in the land version, effectively making it an epic ground mount. This movement speed bonus will not be granted if Travel Form is activated while in combat. At level 30, Flight Form is learned, allowing Travel Form to fly after training Expert Riding.

Transports are huge, skeletal ships charged with ferrying Horde troops across large bodies of water. Being slow and bulky, Transports rely upon magical armor to repel enemy fire. Although the Horde is known to defend their Transports with Destroyers and Juggernaughts, some reckless crews will sail straight into a naval engagement to deliver their troops to land.
Treacherous Guardians were Undercity Guardians that sided with Grand Apothecary Putress and Varimathras and attacked the Alliance and Horde during the Battle for the Undercity.

The Tree of Life is a mighty enchanted sapling of the World Tree, Nordrassil, from which the night elves draw their life energies. This mysterious ancient is the key to the night elves' immortality and harmonious coexistence with nature. Nordrassil's energy, channeled through the tree of life, allows the night elves to benefit from its powers regardless of the vast distances that might separate them. The Tree of Life can grow into the Tree of Ages.
Treebole's Hoop is an ring. It gives bonuses to intellect, critical strike, spell power, and mana regeneration. This is Treebole's ring.

Tripping the Rifts was the Cataclysm launch event Feat of Strength. To receive this achievement, players had to close one of each of the four types of elemental rifts and receive their buffs during the Elemental Unrest. Elemental invasion camps could be found in every quest zone in Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor, Outland and Northrend. They could also be found in Stormwind, Ironforge, Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff every three hours, from midnight server time (so 00:00, 03:00, 06:00 and so on). Elementals that were found within major cities however, were much more powerful and had to be approached with extreme caution.

The Tribunal of the Tides is a group of water elementals who seek to end the eons-long war between water and fire elementals. Neptulon took a personal interest in seeing the fire elementals of Stonetalon Mountains extinguished. The Tribunal sent Tsunaman to carry out the task. Tsunaman asked the adventurers of the Horde to help him destroy the fire elementals and—by doing so—gain favor with the Tribunal. This plot is continued with the Hydraxian Waterlords, but there is no indication that Duke Hydraxis is a member.

Trent Kaniuga is an artist who worked at Blizzard Entertainment from 2006 to 2019. He was a Concept Designer on The Burning Crusade and Wrath of the Lich King, as well as an artist for the TCG and Hearthstone. Kaniuga left Blizzard because he prefers working with smaller teams where he can connect with the players and the development team, a connection which he felt he lost when Blizzard quickly grew into a larger company. He currently runs the independent art house [http://www.aquatic-moon.com/ Aquatic Moon], which does contract work for Blizzard, , and other companies. He and his team notably did the artwork for Travelers second volume.
The Trident of Deep Ocean is looted from the Ocean Chest in Freehold in Tiragarde Sound.

Triumphant Turtle Tossing is awarded to players who manage a perfect round of the Ring Toss at the Darkmoon Faire. It awards the Darkmoon Ring-Flinger toy.

Tuesday morning downtime is a period between 5am and 11am PST/PDT on a Tuesday morning when Blizzard Entertainment takes down all of the North American and Oceanic World of Warcraft realms for weekly maintenance. As a result, no one can play World of Warcraft during that period upon the servers hosted in North America. This also affects the Oceanic servers, especially as this downtime window cuts into the Tuesday evening for New Zealand, Australian and Asian players. When Blizzard deems it necessary the weekly maintenance may also be extended, often for preparing for patches.
